# Andy题词 (andytici)

> Andy题词 is a native macOS teleprompter for Chinese-speaking video creators, made by AI Chief Andy (AI 酋长 Andy). Instead of scrolling on a timer, it uses Chinese speech recognition through the Mac microphone and moves the highlight to the words you actually said, so you can keep your eyes near the camera.

Author: AI Chief Andy / AI 酋长 Andy (Andy Liu), GitHub https://github.com/AIPMAndy , X https://x.com/AIPMAndy , website https://metaver.vip/
